recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-25179 unless Vocabulary opens a new final decision revisiting the broader normative/tooling compatibility question.
issue_request: FHIR-25179 asked Vocabulary to change ValueSet.compose.include.valueSet from saying multiple referenced value sets are unioned to saying they are intersected, and to update the Value Set Expansion guidance so unions are represented by multiple compose.include entries.
initial_application: The R5 ValueSet work applied the requested wording in 9fca6ca36f, that merge was reverted in 5161923416, and the same source changes were reapplied in 054eabf311. The current source retains the intersection definition and expansion algorithm.
additional_context: FHIR-30574 later raised the same inconsistency and was closed Resolved - No Change / Not Persuasive as duplicate/background. A 2022 terminology Zulip thread questioned compatibility but recorded that FHIR-25179 remained the intended forward rule with tooling/legacy handling. Confluence minutes show later review questions but no discovered final reversal.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml already contains the requested intersection definition and source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml already describes adding the intersection of referenced value-set result sets to the expansion. An exact source search found no remaining stale union definition phrase.
